Strongly advises against initiating high-dose mushroom supplements without prior approval from the prescribing physician or pharmacist due to the known warfarin-herb interaction.
Recommends more frequent INR monitoring if the patient insists on trying the mushrooms, or suggests safer, non-interacting alternatives for general wellness.
